Chapter 589: Chapter 25: The God Among Men (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

But at this time, whether it was Lin Yuan’s doing had become irrelevant. With so many True God Incarnations descending, it was entirely possible for them to mistakenly kill Longshan Yuan in an accident.

Longshan Ling and other core members of the Longshan Family also noticed several hundred ‘Jiezi’ figures emerge in the palm of their Patriarch.

However, they didn’t pay it much attention; the most pressing matter was to follow the Rank Pope into the Rank Church before those True God Incarnations arrived.

Only by the grace of the great Main God of Rank could they deter those True God Incarnations.

Anxiety also filled the heart of the Rank Pope standing beside them. The descent of hundreds of True God Incarnations was a pressure even for him.

...

Relying on his identity as an affiliated spirit of the Main God of Rank, the Rank Pope was certain that the incarnations would not dare to lay a hand on him.

But as for Lin Yuan…

Firstly, Lin Yuan was not a follower of the Main God of Rank; if he indeed had something to do with the disappearance of the Demigod, the Rank Pope had no reason to protect him.

Only by entering the Rank Church could they invoke the untouchable majesty of the Main God of Rank to block those True God Incarnations.

“Longshan Patriarch, there’s no time to lose,” the Rank Pope looked toward Lin Yuan, already considering the idea of forcibly taking him into the church.

Lin Yuan had publicly revealed his strength as a Demigod, but the Rank Pope’s true self was a True God from the Ocean of Light, and although he was but an affiliated spirit of a Main God, his strength was slightly greater than that of a Lower-Rank God.

Even if his current flesh was merely a human vessel, forcibly taking away a Demigod would pose no problem.

“Longshan Patriarch, please forgive my offense…”

The Rank Pope took a deep breath; before making his move, he subconsciously glanced at the palm of Lin Yuan’s right hand.

“Huh?”

The Rank Pope took another look.

Then a third look.

A fourth look.

A fifth look.

Until finally, the Rank Pope’s gaze was fixedly staring at the palm of Lin Yuan’s right hand.

Within the palm, several hundred ‘Jiezi’ figures appeared like headless flies, frantically scrambling around but always failing to escape from the confines of the palm.

For a Demigod, this was not unusual; capturing some flies and trapping them in one’s palm was quite simple.

But the Rank Pope’s forehead was now covered in cold sweat.

If Lin Yuan’s palm was magnified a hundred million times, those ‘Jiezi’ figures within would also be magnified a hundred million times.

It would be revealed that these ‘Jiezi’ figures were embodiments with tremendous aura, far surpassing the peak of a Demigod, True God Incarnations.

“True God Incarnations?”

The Rank Pope felt this was absurd.

A True God Incarnation was a continuation of a True God’s will, and even the incarnation of a Lower-Rank God approximates the threshold of an Eighth Layer True God.

But now, these True God Incarnations were struggling like ants in Lin Yuan’s palm?

How could this be possible?

“This is wrong.”

The Rank Pope immediately looked towards the edge of the sky.

Just a moment ago, to be precise, before Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand and those several hundred ‘Jiezi’ figures emerged in his palm,

The Rank Pope could distinctly feel terrifying auras rapidly approaching Longshan Ling.

Those should have been the True God Incarnations coming to seek accountability.

But now,

All of those auras had vanished without a trace.

The Rank Pope had originally thought that the incarnations concealed their presence out of wariness of the Rank Church.

But now, the Rank Pope, staring at the struggling ‘Jiezi’ figures in Lin Yuan’s palm and considering the sudden disappearance of the incarnations’ auras,

A terrible thought suddenly surfaced in his mind.

At the same time,

In the Ocean of Light far away, the true body of the Rank Pope began to contact those gods who had come to hold others accountable.

These True God Incarnations might have been trapped in Lin Yuan’s palm, but their true selves were still free, although at this moment they were in complete disarray.

“All True God Incarnations are trapped in an unknown and vast space, unable to break free, unable to return to the Ocean of Light…”

“Some True Gods wonder if it was the hand of the Prime God of the dark abyss?”

The Rank Pope uncontrollably swallowed his saliva, his gaze still fixed on Lin Yuan’s right palm.

Trapped in an unknown and vast space?

Could it be the palm of the Longshan Patriarch?

Waves of shock crashed in the heart of the Rank Pope, and he could no longer maintain a calm expression.

“`

Because it was beyond belief.

Just a demigod from the Longshan Family, and merely by lifting and retracting his right hand, he trapped hundreds of True God Incarnations in his palm?

This was no longer within the capabilities of True Gods, and even an Upper-Rank God of great power couldn’t possibly possess such skills.

This was the work of a Prime God.

The realm of a Ninth Rank Prime God.

Even the Rank Pope felt that for a Ninth Rank Prime God, killing a few hundred True Gods might not be a difficult task, but to play with hundreds of True Gods at the spatial level like Lin Yuan did? Perhaps even those Prime Gods not proficient in spatial abilities couldn’t achieve this with such nonchalance.

Defeating and killing are two different things.

Killing and toying with them are equally distinct.

“Longshan Patriarch, you… you…” the Rank Pope’s voice trembled as he looked at Lin Yuan, whose back was turned to him, his gaze wandering into space.

“It’s over.”

“Those True God Incarnations won’t be coming anymore.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Rank Pope and then at the confused-looking core members of the Longshan Family like Longshan Ling.

Immediately after, Lin Yuan slightly raised his right hand, brought his face close to his palm, and took a gentle breath.

…

World within the palm.

After the initial panic and confusion, hundreds of True God Incarnations immediately began to collaborate, trying to break the prison and return to the human world.

Space has its limits, and even the most expansive human world can be torn apart layer by layer by the battles among gods.

This Spatial Prison that had them trapped should be the same.

If hundreds of True God Incarnations joined forces, the energy they released should reach the level of an Upper-Rank God.

At that point, even if they couldn’t tear apart the prison, they estimated that they could at least shake it a bit, and that would be their chance.

However, after many attempts by the group of True God Incarnations and tearing through millions of Spatial Layers of this Spatial Prison, they still couldn’t see its end.

“Such a thick Spatial Prison, which Prime God from the dark abyss made this move?”

A True God Incarnation couldn’t help but speak out. At first, they didn’t think it was the deed of a Prime God because the Prime Gods wouldn’t be so idle.

But as they continuously probed and understood the Spatial Prison, their astonishment intensified. Other than a Prime God, who else could create such a space?

“What do we do now?”

“Ask for help from the Prime God of the Ocean of Light?”

The many True Self Incarnations seemed somewhat helpless.

Suddenly.

Just then.

Above this piece of heaven and earth, a face appeared that took up half the sky.

The size of one eye on this face was as large as the sun, and without emitting any presence, it still made all godly incarnations’ souls tremble.

Before the True Self Incarnations could react.

They saw the immense face turn towards them and take a gentle breath.

Instantly, a terrifying force permeated every inch of space, all True Self Incarnations were scattered into nothingness, even the Upper-Rank Gods’ True Self Incarnations didn’t last a moment.

The True Selves were incarnations of divine power, not flesh and blood, created from the purest divine force, and at that moment, all divine incarnations returned to their origins, turning into a vast amount of pure energy and flowing into the ‘mouth’ of that vast face.

Outside.

Lin Yuan ‘ate’ all the divine power incarnations in one bite, and with his current size, the energy contained within these embodiments was no more than a dessert after a meal, barely offering a taste.

“It’s done.”

Lin Yuan patted his right hand, and swept a look over the rigid Rank Pope, and the still confused core members of the Longshan Family like Longshan Ling, who hadn’t yet grasped what had happened.

“There is no danger now.”

“Go about your business.”

After speaking, Lin Yuan walked straight into the Longshan Great Hall, dealing with the divine force incarnations of the hundreds of True Gods without any difficulty.

As a Ninth Rank who had opened ninety million Spatial Layers, Lin Yuan’s expertise in space was such that even some Tenth Rankers in the Main World might not boldly claim they could best him, much less in this world?

“Patriarch…”

The core members of the Longshan Family like Longshan Ling blinked, still not recovered, wondering what meant by there being no danger? Hadn’t the Rank Pope just said that many True God Incarnations were on their way over to seek accountability?

“Your Holiness, what, in heaven’s name, happened?”

Longshan Ling looked towards the Rank Pope next to him, his expression still anxious.

“….”

The Rank Pope.
